contract_refinements.contract_kind: existing component and application composition refinement
contract_refinements.runtime_status: partial; behavior and accessibility contract not verified in this design batch
contract_refinements.proposed_owner: RustUI SearchField for in-app query entry; GPUI popup/menu surface for suggestions when explicitly composed. Token chips remain an application composition; no TokenInput public component is proposed.

semantic_parts.role: optional search affordance; decorative unless it conveys an action
programmatic and visible name, distinct from placeholder
editable query text
named action available only when a query exists
optional list of recent or matching choices
selected query token in an app-owned composition; removable only with an explicit action
text entry following or preceding tokens according to the documented interaction model

states: invalid (only when the owning app defines validation)

requirements: Provide a stable accessible name independent of placeholder text.
Expose expanded state and active suggestion when a suggestion list is open.
Give the clear action its own localized name and keyboard focus target.
Announce result-count changes only when useful; do not announce every keystroke.
Expose each token as text with a separately named removal action when removal is supported.
keyboard: Return submits or accepts the active option according to an explicit owner policy.
Up/Down moves through suggestions only while the suggestion surface is open.
Escape closes suggestions before clearing or cancelling query state.
Tab order follows the logical field, token actions, then suggestion content without trapping focus.
accessibility_contract.verification_status: design obligation only; no accessibility tree, VoiceOver, or keyboard test was run

localization_and_layout: Localize the field name, placeholder, clear action, recent-search labels, and result announcements.
Use logical leading/trailing placement; keep query content and embedded identifiers readable in mixed-direction text.
Keep popups anchored to the field and constrain them to available window space.
Define whether tokens wrap, scroll, or remain in a single row; do not silently clip removable tokens.
Test narrow widths, long localized labels, large text, and RTL direction.
fallbacks: If suggestions are unavailable, retain a plain editable search field and omit the popup affordance.
If token interaction has no owner contract, render tokens as static app content and do not imply removability.
unsupported_or_unresolved: Whether token entry is a reusable RustUI control or only an app composition.
Whether SearchField supports a stable label, clear-action keyboard semantics, suggestions, and result announcements.
The screenshot does not establish native Spotlight behavior or any existing implementation capability.

contract_refinements.runtime_status: partial; the design does not establish editable/noneditable behavior support
contract_refinements.proposed_owner: RustUI ComboBox for its value and selection contract; GPUI popup/menu surface for an in-app option list. Native menus remain separately owned.

semantic_parts.role: stable accessible name
editable text or selected option, chosen by the control mode
named action that opens or closes the options
list of selectable options with stable identities
keyboard-active option, distinct from committed value

requirements: Expose the current value, expanded state, selected option, and disabled state.
Keep the active option distinct from the committed value until selection is accepted.
Give the popup and each option stable names and identities.
keyboard: Arrow navigation follows an explicit option-selection model.
Return commits the active option; Escape closes without committing.
Type-to-select or filtering must be documented separately for editable and selection-only modes.
accessibility_contract.verification_status: design obligation only; no semantic or keyboard behavior was verified

localization_and_layout: Localize option labels and sorting/filtering rules using the active locale.
Preserve user-entered query text in bidi content; mirror only directional affordances.
Anchor the option list to the control and constrain height with scrolling rather than clipping options.
Test long labels, large text, narrow windows, and RTL layouts.
fallbacks: Use a labeled text field only when free-form input is allowed.
Use a labeled button plus in-app menu only for selection-only mode; keep committed value visible.
unsupported_or_unresolved: Editable and selection-only modes may have different keyboard contracts; the source API must decide whether both are supported.
The P05 image is a design reference and does not prove the option popup or accessibility behavior exists.

contract_refinements.contract_kind: existing surfaces plus source-present context-menu refinement
contract_refinements.runtime_status: partial/reference-only mix; see the per-ID classification in the preserved 41-record audit
contract_refinements.proposed_owner: GPUI Components owns its menu surface and menu item rendering; RustUI owns in-app context-menu composition where its component is used. The host owns the macOS menu bar and native menu integration.

semantic_parts.role: button or selection trigger that names the action/menu
transient in-app menu container
action or selection row with stable label
checked or mixed selection indicator, not decoration alone
visible keyboard equivalent associated with the action
directional relationship to a nested menu
visual grouping only unless a meaningful group label exists

requirements: Expose item name, enabled state, checked/mixed state, shortcut description, and submenu relationship.
Do not use color alone to distinguish destructive, checked, or focused rows.
Restore focus to the trigger or context target on dismissal according to the opening interaction.
keyboard: Arrow keys move between eligible items; Home/End behavior is documented if provided.
Return or Space activates the focused item.
Escape closes the deepest open menu first.
Type-ahead is locale-aware and does not conflict with explicit shortcuts.
accessibility_contract.verification_status: design obligation only; no GPUI or RustUI menu audit was run in this batch

localization_and_layout: Mirror submenu placement and directional disclosure in RTL while retaining non-directional semantic icons.
Keep shortcut glyphs and key names stable; localize spoken descriptions.
Constrain menu placement to the visible window and allow scrolling for long menus.
Test long translated labels, mixed-direction text, and nested menus.
fallbacks: Use an in-app popup menu when native menu integration is unavailable; label it as app-owned.
Keep separators decorative and omit them from accessibility navigation.
A split button is a composition proposal using an action trigger and menu trigger; do not infer a new supported public component.
unsupported_or_unresolved: `menu_separator` and `button_group` retain their existing reference-only classifications until a renderer contract is established.
AppKit menu-bar ownership and native keyboard conventions are not specified by the P08 concept.
Context-menu pointer, keyboard, touchpad, focus, and dismissal behavior require source and runtime review.

contract_refinements.contract_kind: native system integration reference; not a RustUI widget component
contract_refinements.runtime_status: native-only design candidate; no integration is claimed
contract_refinements.proposed_owner: WidgetKit and the macOS host own real desktop widgets; macOS owns system-control surfaces; the notification system owns delivered notification presentation. RustUI may show an app-contained preview only if clearly presented as a preview.

semantic_parts.role: small, medium, or large information layout selected by the host
localized status, action summary, or data visualization
explicitly supported intent/action entry point
current value plus enabled/selected state for a system-owned control
title, body, timestamp, and any system-approved actions

requirements: Give each widget a concise name and expose values and state without relying on chart color.
Describe charts with a textual summary or data alternative.
Give every action a stable localized name and preserve the system surface focus/activation model.
Do not claim VoiceOver behavior from the static image.
accessibility_contract.verification_status: not applicable to this image-only concept; native API accessibility must be tested in a future integration task

localization_and_layout: Use locale-aware dates, numbers, units, and relative times.
Fit content to host-selected widget families and larger text settings without clipping essential values.
Treat RTL as a layout input while preserving semantic icon direction.
For notifications, distinguish system-delivered notifications from in-app toast/alert content.
fallbacks: An app-owned static preview may be used inside Playground or documentation, clearly labeled preview-only.
When no native widget or notification integration exists, do not show an app-owned surface as a system widget or delivered notification.
unsupported_or_unresolved: Whether RustUI should build a WidgetKit extension, and its lifecycle/data ownership, is undecided.
No Control Center extension/integration capability is asserted by the screenshot.
The image does not prove native widget, system-control, notification, permission, or VoiceOver support.
Design and dependency approval is required before any AppKit/WidgetKit bridge or native surface is implemented.
